items.title: CJ McCollum said he’s been working out with Kingston Flemings (and NAW) in the mornings and he praised him quite a bit.
items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
CJ McCollum said he’s been working out with Kingston Flemings (and NAW) in the mornings and he praised him quite a bit.

Said Flemings is “super smart” and “ahead of his time” compared to a typical rookie guard.

Also complimented his work ethic and buy-in and how much he cares.
